name: Kirk Cameron
subject: We Only Have One Month
body:
In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress.

In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress.
| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc1u2zoQhZ-G2tHgXyhqoYUDW8EF4tvCNVJ0RQzJkU1UIgWKctC3LxwkD9DtwTcz-Ob8PNkTxCmm6_8wY1_qaMtq3zGn6c8N7pgTzjnVmxVMaMo6yrQFX-MdrYIm9MEH4L7BnrfG6I5ppZpbb1hoPR-ZCEqDk9KgEs6MTjpmOua6JvaPfaxjmjPJlNwxwFaic6MP4DBoohhMWOqu4LK5KXpIFdbfYy4edz7PzdTfal1WIvdEDEQMK_qt4A4ShlwfBBGDK3BHOuZCrzkHIoYFmOFylMFQJ5FTxUVHjQuGguy60D4Fyf0TkcNWZ7vmrXgk8nA-vhGhH9GMIW4zkYfjaf_f62foYV4gXhORh08pbp8PL_Z5ePlmz8c3-wHbH7_2l1d-ot_39HwZvmZzqpjq48hloF8_aUoflvc4TXHVLVHsOkOcPqzrvzZ078XfAAAA__8Wm5mI)
---
Dear Friend, **In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress.** On September 26, I will kick off this year's "See You at the Library" Story Hours at America's Library in Washington, D.C.Then, just one week later, something truly incredible will happen. Christian parents and grandparents across America will walk into their local public libraries with their children and grandchildren.And in a matter of hours, hundreds of Story Hours will fill children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.This is our chance to bring God's truth into libraries across America and reach an entire generation of children. **This year, honoring America's 250th birthday, our ambitious goal is to expand "See You at the Library Day" to reach 250,000 children.****And we are just ONE MONTH away.** Before then, I need you!The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host "Story Hours" has been overwhelming.But it's going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold "Story Hours" for 250,000 children.**And with just over one month left, the clock is running out to fund the Story Hours we need to reach 250,000 children.** **[That's why I'm asking you to rush back your tax-deductible sponsorship gift of $35, $50, $125, $250 or more today.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc1u2zoQhZ-G2tHgXyhqoYUDW8EF4tvCNVJ0RQzJkU1UIgWKctC3LxwkD9DtwTcz-Ob8PNkTxCmm6_8wY1_qaMtq3zGn6c8N7pgTzjnVmxVMaMo6yrQFX-MdrYIm9MEH4L7BnrfG6I5ppZpbb1hoPR-ZCEqDk9KgEs6MTjpmOua6JvaPfaxjmjPJlNwxwFaic6MP4DBoohhMWOqu4LK5KXpIFdbfYy4edz7PzdTfal1WIvdEDEQMK_qt4A4ShlwfBBGDK3BHOuZCrzkHIoYFmOFylMFQJ5FTxUVHjQuGguy60D4Fyf0TkcNWZ7vmrXgk8nA-vhGhH9GMIW4zkYfjaf_f62foYV4gXhORh08pbp8PL_Z5ePlmz8c3-wHbH7_2l1d-ot_39HwZvmZzqpjq48hloF8_aUoflvc4TXHVLVHsOkOcPqzrvzZ078XfAAAA__8Wm5mI)** Friend, America's children need to hear our message because today's "educators" and librarians are radicals! Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, radical activists have worked to turn our public libraries into vehicles for their values.But we can't just sit back and complain about it. **[That's why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through "See You at the Library Day."](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc1u2zoQhZ-G2tHgXyhqoYUDW8EF4tvCNVJ0RQzJkU1UIgWKctC3LxwkD9DtwTcz-Ob8PNkTxCmm6_8wY1_qaMtq3zGn6c8N7pgTzjnVmxVMaMo6yrQFX-MdrYIm9MEH4L7BnrfG6I5ppZpbb1hoPR-ZCEqDk9KgEs6MTjpmOua6JvaPfaxjmjPJlNwxwFaic6MP4DBoohhMWOqu4LK5KXpIFdbfYy4edz7PzdTfal1WIvdEDEQMK_qt4A4ShlwfBBGDK3BHOuZCrzkHIoYFmOFylMFQJ5FTxUVHjQuGguy60D4Fyf0TkcNWZ7vmrXgk8nA-vhGhH9GMIW4zkYfjaf_f62foYV4gXhORh08pbp8PL_Z5ePlmz8c3-wHbH7_2l1d-ot_39HwZvmZzqpjq48hloF8_aUoflvc4TXHVLVHsOkOcPqzrvzZ078XfAAAA__8Wm5mI)** We're countering those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And on October 3, a little boy or girl will stand up at their public library as straight and tall as they possibly can... ...as their right hand covers their heart, and they proudly pledge allegiance to our American flag.We'll teach them:**Freedom Requires Courage.****Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice.****IN GOD WE TRUST.** And we hope to engrave those lessons on every child's heart at "See You at the Library Day."But first, we have to get the resources into the hands of the parents, grandparents, and patriots who are organizing these Story Hours.Your tax-deductible sponsorship gift helps send a "Story Hour Kit" to volunteers organizing "See You at the Library" events. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. **[Knowing that, please consider a tax-deductible sponsorship gift of $125.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc1u2zoQhZ-G2tHgXyhqoYUDW8EF4tvCNVJ0RQzJkU1UIgWKctC3LxwkD9DtwTcz-Ob8PNkTxCmm6_8wY1_qaMtq3zGn6c8N7pgTzjnVmxVMaMo6yrQFX-MdrYIm9MEH4L7BnrfG6I5ppZpbb1hoPR-ZCEqDk9KgEs6MTjpmOua6JvaPfaxjmjPJlNwxwFaic6MP4DBoohhMWOqu4LK5KXpIFdbfYy4edz7PzdTfal1WIvdEDEQMK_qt4A4ShlwfBBGDK3BHOuZCrzkHIoYFmOFylMFQJ5FTxUVHjQuGguy60D4Fyf0TkcNWZ7vmrXgk8nA-vhGhH9GMIW4zkYfjaf_f62foYV4gXhORh08pbp8PL_Z5ePlmz8c3-wHbH7_2l1d-ot_39HwZvmZzqpjq48hloF8_aUoflvc4TXHVLVHsOkOcPqzrvzZ078XfAAAA__8Wm5mI)** That's enough to sponsor one entire "**Story Hour Kit** " yourself. **Singlehandedly, you'll be helping us reach approximately 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message.** But October 3 is getting closer every day.We don't have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA.We have something better: **Parents. Grandparents. Christians. Patriots. And people like you who refuse to surrender America's children.** **[Whatever you can give, whether it's $35, $125, $250, $500 or more, please send in your sponsorship gift today so we can sponsor as many Story Hours as possible before October 3.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc1u2zoQhZ-G2tHgXyhqoYUDW8EF4tvCNVJ0RQzJkU1UIgWKctC3LxwkD9DtwTcz-Ob8PNkTxCmm6_8wY1_qaMtq3zGn6c8N7pgTzjnVmxVMaMo6yrQFX-MdrYIm9MEH4L7BnrfG6I5ppZpbb1hoPR-ZCEqDk9KgEs6MTjpmOua6JvaPfaxjmjPJlNwxwFaic6MP4DBoohhMWOqu4LK5KXpIFdbfYy4edz7PzdTfal1WIvdEDEQMK_qt4A4ShlwfBBGDK3BHOuZCrzkHIoYFmOFylMFQJ5FTxUVHjQuGguy60D4Fyf0TkcNWZ7vmrXgk8nA-vhGhH9GMIW4zkYfjaf_f62foYV4gXhORh08pbp8PL_Z5ePlmz8c3-wHbH7_2l1d-ot_39HwZvmZzqpjq48hloF8_aUoflvc4TXHVLVHsOkOcPqzrvzZ078XfAAAA__8Wm5mI)****We have just over one month.** And we have 250,000 children we're fighting to reach.Thank you!God Bless You and God Bless America,
---
| | | In faith and freedom,**Dr. Trent Talbot** Founder, BRAVE For Good

Christian parents and grandparents across America will walk into their local public libraries with their children and grandchildren.And in a matter of hours, hundreds of Story Hours will fill children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.This is our chance to bring God's truth into libraries across America and reach an entire generation of children. This year, honoring America's 250th birthday, our ambitious goal is to expand "See You at the Library Day" to reach 250,000 children.And we are just ONE MONTH away. ## Education Board Finalizes Social Studies Rewrite
The State Board of Education gave final approval Friday to high school social studies standards requiring students to learn that the Sept. 11 attacks were motivated by ["radical Islam"](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU8DmZExxrQDB5uQ9aYbonK5aCwZjGwDvbcf0RppDjDZC6q-_n__ntMTfPDb6y-sZMp7jtNGVw5UCqUJj5Q8HuFYcYHtRdnRmkvEOAkuFOOacTUBFn_SJKF2xnKn25pMOzweSote6XoxOOCj73vlet32FoTuLGDHJUmN2na29uaO45qrtuVCDk0vFCds5wGEHGzLK8nJ-RJTUxYq9IY8h__xpNRgXOtgllL2XHV_KjFWYryuq5njW95D7oNKjDdWYvy8MnIHQvFxYzZCcgz2PcWTMsO4lZtS9hBYxiXGwH4csG8JdTJuv3wIPquhkvy1gg-fJuW3Bk8jvgIAAP__hfuKXA). That wording replaces a narrower focus on the terrorist groups behind the attacks. Lessons also present the Prophet Muhammad as a warrior who spread the faith through violence and slavery. The Republican majority [approved each section](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAQRb9GdxioVmkWLGbTuzfbWZoCCiVBMVDab_5-8voXZntzc3Jy_nwtX5hyOtbfuJPl71iWg94tEzPVxV-1Jn_la_cbHiu1QHvj4ssCEmYhjZDzgp7TTcuIfbBOBqN6sko_n7OBaTb9Zp9uUqAfClArdBOQMRCj0xAe0cig-2R_cNLIWSkJox4mmCV5FTXCqJ2S3SgpJC514I2YvrHF_LfcVAdf9j7bjfls3eNXB68OXs0VGj6vYS33z8DIJFzBGkSJgsLlkVM5OniNYmvCl6s2auKdeBO-RCfwPGu5KQjc6Qg7HdyGM8S-2nC-U86pzbob5bpjyh8H_t92t4V_AQAA__9dtoaH) after testimony that ran mostly against it. Member Julie Pickren, who backed the changes, said the vote "bookends 12 years of life's work." Muslim speakers had asked members to restore a deleted standard on Muslim contributions to algebra and astronomy. The advocacy group CAIR says it will work to overturn the standards, which reach classrooms in 2030.
## Texas Democrats Counter GOP Convention
Texas Democrats [will open a media center in Dallas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_uozAQhJ_GdET2QuxQuLiGLtdeiTb2Apb8B9lLknv7E_cKv3o0M_q-P8_liSGGvP3GRJa_a1kyfVokZqqLO2sN7oxncjvmjZqn1Li4soAE3cupl3pBx-FNy4idty_pJ9WRVebx0BPc9dTtdlhHQq-U8cqgH6aX09LrYRhWgBXJdMFec3KSWikJo7ndQUtyajUIo3kpKUZJPnCpN96J6YttjX_Lm-rNldRFuzMfTQy_BMwCZt5pDzFemYB5L4kuJAGzw3Rg2LKAWUsD9wF6T6m4itx6V87MVI9atoophbz1NbveY4x4lbtq_fEJMYamjRjlljD8_-j4p97eFv4FAAD__znlhFY) next week to offer commentary and interviews during the Republican National Committee's midterm convention. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries is sending four members of his caucus to work alongside state and local Democrats. They plan to press Republicans on the cost of living. More than a dozen organizations are planning rallies downtown. Kardal Coleman, who chairs the Dallas County Democrats, said [fundraisers and demonstrations](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAYhJ8GOw38siAFxTV2e-2VBuF3JQHdwO-69_YX9xWuncnMZL6f-3R3McXt8e0yWnov-7ThWRMSYZn8UUr0RzqyX932wBowV9r9PgEH1XLTcjU5T_GFk3RNsDMPRjRohR4GZeCmTLPaQaMwWrpZ9ii062cJajDCD7Bwr5a-ifaq44YrIThI3d1AcfRi0Q6kngVnkmOItJeOViR8u7qk3_2FpfN7bpJdiZ6V9V8MRgbjeZ6dn-v14_IZjJ8Ig_GSGIw5BsKS27L5NriUXG2pHPnJYGyKDc8zphSr0kzyR3YxfVbov3ReFv4CAAD__9KDerA) are in the works. National Democrats weighed holding a midterm convention of their own and decided against it. The RNC says its two-day gathering at American Airlines Center, which President Trump closes Thursday, will highlight the party's record and candidates ahead of November.
## Metros Top Texas Income Rankings
A Tarrant County suburb of about 31,500 people holds the [highest median household income](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL9u8yAUxZ_G3rCuCQYzMHyLt3xrRwvDdUDFJoKbOO3TV47UJ-j8O390zsd1vtqY4n77bzc09FrzvONRExJhmd2jlOge6bG5YPcbVo9bpezyzIFLBpqBnK2j-MRZ2NabBbzuWzS9Gkep-SB1G8wy4KK1BIGglAOxXkZ1AT2sUi1eibGN5owDDbLvgQvVDVwCun5Vlgu19NAIQB8pl44CEr5sXdNXfmLpXN7aZALRvTaXfw2fGj4dx9F9vux-woZP556GT2_bSYMlFiujgKxEF7AS-4535rJHFnf2q2uL8fcjphSrVI2A22ZjevfRX396Gv4TAAD__2PlfdA) of any ZIP code in Texas. weeks.

When we organize, we win.

It worked - but it emptied our account. Winning a runoff doesn't put a dollar back in the bank. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million from liberal donors nationwide while we fought a two-round primary just to get on the ballot. I promised South Carolina I'd carry the conservative agenda to the Senate for six more years. President Trump stood with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I'm not letting her bank account break that promise. The general is November 3 - less than 65 days out. Every week from now until then, she's on TV, in your mailbox, on your phone. | | Peter,

In two months, Kansans will decide what kind of future we want for our state.

For me, this race is about keeping Kansas affordable, cutting taxes, creating good-paying jobs, supporting our farmers and small businesses, and making sure our kids have every opportunity to build their future right here at home.

We have 58 days to take our message to every corner of Kansas.

Let's get to work.
---
| |
---
| |
---
On the Trail with Ty
---
| | Really enjoyed stopping by Wichita Technical Institute and Heartland Welding Academy to see the work they're doing to train the next generation of Kansas workers.
These students are learning real skills that can turn into great careers, good pay, and opportunities right here at home.
We need to keep expanding these kinds of pathways and make sure young Kansans know that a four-year degree isn't the only way to build a successful future.
---

| Ag Endorsements
---
| | I'm honored to have earned the endorsements of both the Kansas Agri Business Council PAC and the Renew Kansas Biofuels Association.
Kansas agriculture is the beating heart of our state's economy, and the farmers, ranchers, producers, and businesses behind it deserve a government that understands the challenges they face.
A strong Kansas starts with standing behind the farmers, producers, and industries that power our economy. I'll always fight to make sure they have the opportunity to grow, compete, and succeed.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |

| The Field Report
---
| This is exactly what happens when common sense gets thrown out the window.
The Justice Department is suing Kansas City, Kansas Public Schools, alleging the district directed staff to help children socially transition at school without informing or getting consent from their parents. DOJ says the policy violated federal parental-rights laws.
Schools do not know children better than their parents. They should not be keeping secrets from mom and dad, and they certainly shouldn't be making deeply personal decisions behind their backs.
Kansas needs less radical left ideology in the classroom and a whole lot more common sense.

clean_body: | | | | | == | | Peter, In two months, Kansans will decide what kind of future we want for our state. For me, this race is about keeping Kansas affordable, cutting taxes, creating good-paying jobs, supporting our farmers and small businesses, and making sure our kids have every opportunity to build their future right here at home. We have 58 days to take our message to every corner of Kansas. Let's get to work. | | | | On the Trail with Ty | | Really enjoyed stopping by Wichita Technical Institute and Heartland Welding Academy to see the work they're doing to train the next generation of Kansas workers. These students are learning real skills that can turn into great careers, good pay, and opportunities right here at home. We need to keep expanding these kinds of pathways and make sure young Kansans know that a four-year degree isn't the only way to build a successful future. | | | | | | | | | | | Ag Endorsements | | I'm honored to have earned the endorsements of both the Kansas Agri Business Council PAC and the Renew Kansas Biofuels Association. Kansas agriculture is the beating heart of our state's economy, and the farmers, ranchers, producers, and businesses behind it deserve a government that understands the challenges they face. A strong Kansas starts with standing behind the farmers, producers, and industries that power our economy. I'll always fight to make sure they have the opportunity to grow, compete, and succeed. | | | | | | | The Field Report | This is exactly what happens when common sense gets thrown out the window. The Justice Department is suing Kansas City, Kansas Public Schools, alleging the district directed staff to help children socially transition at school without informing or getting consent from their parents. DOJ says the policy violated federal parental-rights laws. Schools do not know children better than their parents. They should not be keeping secrets from mom and dad, and they certainly shouldn't be making deeply personal decisions behind their backs. Kansas needs less radical left ideology in the classroom and a whole lot more common sense. | | == | | | Join Ty's Team | Your support is how we will win this race. The battle for the future of our state is not one I can take on alone. Join my team by contributing your time, talents, or treasures to our mission to Take Back Kansas. | == | == Thank you for your support. At 17 years old, I first raised my right hand and swore an oath to our Constitution.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=83%2E42639%2EGR1pZU)
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q3.tyfWFC&refcode=em260906&refcode2=83.42639.GR1pZU&t=2&akid=83%2E42639%2EGR1pZU)
---
At 17 years old, I first raised my right hand and swore an oath to our Constitution. After the 9/11 attacks during my senior year of high school, I went off to the Naval Academy.
I still remember walking into Memorial Hall. It's where we honor all alumni who have died in service to our country.
I was commissioned as an active-duty surface warfare officer in the U.S. Navy, and went on to serve at sea and then on the ground with a U.S. Army Civil Affairs unit in Iraq.
I first decided to run for Congress in 2021 because my time in uniform shaped me considerably. That is where I learned the power of solidarity, that we don't leave people behind, and that it doesn't matter your class, your race, who you love or what you look like or where you're from – that we are all in this together.
I looked around and didn't see a lot of leaders, especially on the right, who saw the world that way. I saw too many more interested in serving the most powerful corporations and the billionaires who bankroll them.
We won that election and then won again in 2024, a year Trump won in PA.
Today, I'm running for reelection because patriotism demands courage in this moment. The courage to fight for our freedom. The courage to fight the corruption and abuses of the Trump administration. The courage to fight to restore the American dream — a dream that's no longer real, or never was for many. It's been ripped away by powerful corporations and the corruption of concentrated power.
Western PA sent a fighter to Washington. And I am not done.
But I can't win reelection alone. I need you in this fight with me, especially as the last Democrat in Pennsylvania who represents a battleground seat.
So I am asking:
**[Can you please make a contribution to my reelection campaign today? Our average online donation is around $30. Many give more. Some give less. No amount is too small. It will all add up fast when so many are giving what they can.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q3.tyfWFC&refcode=em260906&t=3&akid=83%2E42639%2EGR1pZU)**

A major regulatory shift has quietly taken effect across American retirement accounts in 2026.

Under SECURE 2.0 (Section 603), the IRS has officially activated mandatory Roth rules for catch-up contributions. At the same time, lawmakers in Washington have introduced legislation targeting high-balance IRAs and 401(k)s with mandatory withdrawals and contribution limits.

With over $47.6 trillion currently sitting in U.S. retirement assets, Washington is aggressively shifting rules to collect tax revenue immediately rather than waiting for future payouts.

Renowned retirement expert Bob Carlson - who has tracked Capitol Hill tax policy for over 35 years - warns that most retirees are completely unprepared for how these changes will impact tax liabilities.

For anyone holding assets in a 401(k), Traditional IRA, or Roth IRA, reviewing your strategy today is critical.

**The DC crowd didn't see that coming. The pollsters didn't see it coming. name: Jace Yarbrough
subject: Jesus Christ fell three times carrying the Cross
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Yarbrough for Congress
body:
This fight is heavy, and Jesus Christ is my inspiration.

This fight is heavy, and Jesus Christ is my inspiration.
| Friend,
[Jesus Christ carried the cross to Calvary and fell under its weight three times. He stumbled. He rose. He kept walking, because what waited on that hill was salvation for his children.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
I think about that often. This fight for America is heavy too, and Jesus Christ is my inspiration.
I am a husband and a father to five children, and every waking moment I feel the weight of what we're up against.
[An evil communist-minded movement with no fear of God, working to strip away our freedom to worship, to speak, to raise our own kids by our own conscience.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._u3Yd6-xlg)
[Some days I stumble.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.) I wonder if it's worth the cost.
But Jesus Christ didn't reach the throne by ducking the burden.
[He bore the flogging and mockery and shouldered the cross to his eventual death.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
[](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._l3LHKmpUdChsk7Sxw)
---
That message fuels me when it would be easier to stay quiet.
History won't hand us a second run at this.
That's why I'm asking you to help me carry this weight and rise to the challenge ahead.
[Whatever you can give, $25, $50, $100, is your hand under this cross with mine. ](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
Even under the heaviest load, we do not stumble alone, because Jesus Christ carried it first, and He carries it with us still.
Let's do this together.

[Chip in before midnight!](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-0L-LxXkg)
May God bless you and your family,
Jace Yarbrough

subject: a difficult decision

body:
As someone who cares about electing Democrats, I need to share this with you...
#
Good morning, Peter. Eugene Vindman here.
I recently had to make one of the toughest decisions I've faced this election year, and as someone who cares about the stakes of this election, I need to explain what it and why I made the choice.
When we recently wrapped up the primary for Virginia’s 7th district in Congress, Republicans chose a MAGA nominee to take me on. Since then, **my opponent has been firing attacks at me non-stop. He even went as far as to call me a “traitor.”**
My team and I quickly came together to determine our strategy moving forward. And our best option was to urgently expand our digital advertising and outreach efforts to fend off the attacks and show voters the truth.
The money wasn’t immediately in the budget, but I gave my team the all clear anyway.
I approved the expense because we can’t let my opponent’s attacks go unanswered and because it’s what we need to do in order to compete against the floods of MAGA mega-donor and super PAC money National Republicans are going to pummel me with. I’m already a top target for Trump since blowing the whistle on him 7 years ago. He’s already launched a sham investigation into me to kick me out of Congress, so his allies are going to spend any amount to flip this seat and get me out of Congress.
This decision was a risk, but one I was willing to take, because I’m betting on this grassroots team to help us fill the budget gap. That’s how much faith I have in this team and our pro-democracy movement.
So, on the heels of my difficult budget decision, I’m asking:

Today, I’m asking you to take the next step. Here’s why:

Fundraising has been off to a slow start this month. We’re not just behind where we need to be, we’re raising less than we were at this point in 2024. And we lost that race.

| | **The Big Picture ** Republicans have complete control of the federal government and they are using it to protect their House majority by any means necessary. Taking back the House is the only way to put a check on this administration and that means holding every competitive seat Democrats have. NY-04 is one of them. **Where Things Stand**
* **This district is one of the most competitive in the country.** New reporting has named this district one of the top House targets on Long Island, and identified Laura as the most vulnerable first-term Democrat that Republicans are working to unseat.
* **Long Island is trending redder.** Republican Bruce Blakeman is running to unseat New York's Democratic governor, and local Republicans have made steady gains across Nassau and Suffolk counties. Republicans believe that shift gives them an opening in NY-04.
* **Trump personally traveled to Nassau County this month to campaign for Laura's opponent.** A Republican outside group has pledged $22 million in ad spending across Long Island this fall, on top of tens of millions already spent nationally promoting the GOP's agenda.
* **The GOP have their candidate.** Laura's opponent has Trump's endorsement and a place on the NRCC's list of top-priority candidates, putting the full financial weight of the national party behind her campaign.

**What’s at Stake** If Republicans flip this seat, they’ll have an even stronger grip on the House and a clearer path to push their extreme agenda. But if we hold it, Democrats are one step closer to taking back the House — and exposing the corruption, chaos, and abuses of power that have defined this Republican Congress. **What Laura Needs** We’re building the infrastructure now to win, but it’s going to take consistent support to stay competitive. The next two months are critical to:
* Fund our field and voter contact programs
* Counter GOP attack ads already running in the district
* Build the resources needed to compete against national Republican spending

clean_body: The state of this race | | | | = | | | = | | | | The Big Picture Republicans have complete control of the federal government and they are using it to protect their House majority by any means necessary. Taking back the House is the only way to put a check on this administration and that means holding every competitive seat Democrats have. NY-04 is one of them. Where Things Stand This district is one of the most competitive in the country. New reporting has named this district one of the top House targets on Long Island, and identified Laura as the most vulnerable first-term Democrat that Republicans are working to unseat. Long Island is trending redder. Republican Bruce Blakeman is running to unseat New York's Democratic governor, and local Republicans have made steady gains across Nassau and Suffolk counties. Republicans believe that shift gives them an opening in NY-04. Trump personally traveled to Nassau County this month to campaign for Laura's opponent. A Republican outside group has pledged $22 million in ad spending across Long Island this fall, on top of tens of millions already spent nationally promoting the GOP's agenda. The GOP have their candidate. Laura's opponent has Trump's endorsement and a place on the NRCC's list of top-priority candidates, putting the full financial weight of the national party behind her campaign. What’s at Stake If Republicans flip this seat, they’ll have an even stronger grip on the House and a clearer path to push their extreme agenda. But if we hold it, Democrats are one step closer to taking back the House — and exposing the corruption, chaos, and abuses of power that have defined this Republican Congress. What Laura Needs We’re building the infrastructure now to win, but it’s going to take consistent support to stay competitive. subject: Texans deserve a governor who’s going to fight for their healthcare
body:
Greg Abbott knew this was coming.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**Peter, Texas hospitals are losing $27 million _a day_ in critical Medicaid funding.**
[****](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260906_1_medicaid.z_UsWc&refcode=em20260906-2025&amount=5&t=1&akid=2025%2E299639%2E_TtyB5)
**That’s nearly $10 billion stripped from our healthcare safety net this year alone.**
It means emergency rooms facing major budget cuts, pediatric specialty care will be delayed, and clinics across the state will shut down. **Most of all, this impacts the 4 million Texans enrolled in Medicaid — the vast majority of whom are children.**
**The most infuriating thing about this is that Greg Abbott _knew_ this was coming.**
This collapse didn't happen overnight. This impasse has been dragging on quietly in the background since last December. For over nine months, as hospital leadership has been sounding the alarm, Greg Abbott dragged on taking action. Now, the money has run out, and millions of Texas families are paying the price for his dysfunction.
**I can’t stress this enough. We absolutely can’t afford a governor who sleeps through warning signs while children lose access to healthcare.**
Texans deserve a governor who is on the ball from day one. Someone who will fight relentlessly for our families, protect our local hospitals, and ensure every Texan can get the healthcare they need.

name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, retired
subject: They're going to break ground on the Arc de Trump within two weeks
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
That cemetery is where my father is buried, as well as men I trained and served alongside
#
Peter, they just told us when they’re beginning construction on the Arc de Trump:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep26.f1bOKp&refcode=em260906-1-180&t=1&akid=35544%2E3013755%2EYc8ZzX)
Two weeks. That's how long we have before they break ground.
Back in June, a federal commission packed with Trump appointees voted 8 to 1 to advance this thing, after hearing nearly three hours of public opposition first. That same commission still hasn’t voted on final approval, with their next meeting scheduled for October 1st.
Trump wants to put the graves of our honored dead at Arlington in his shadow. That cemetery is where my father is buried, as well as men I trained and served alongside. It is among the most sacred places in the country. It is not the backdrop for this draft-dodging coward’s vanity project.
So we're asking for $5. That's it.
$5 because they've given us two weeks, and that is not a lot of time.
$5 because we're up against a President who's made this one of the top priorities of his administration — and today, he got himself a start date.
But really, $5 or anything you can afford. Because whatever you can give, right now, matters more than the amount itself.
[**Can we count on you? Chip in that $5 and help VoteVets raise enough hell that they can't force the Arc de Trump through before the shovels hit dirt. When many of us were growing up, the stories we watched and read reinforced things like character, responsibility, and a basic understanding of where our country came from. Those stories weren't perfect--but they helped give us a sense of grounding.

Today, the media children are absorbing looks very different.

So much of what kids watch now either ignores America's history altogether or presents it in confusing and misleading ways. Children are forming their understanding of the world earlier than ever, and without a clear foundation, it's no wonder so many young adults today feel disconnected, uncertain, and adrift.

That's one of the reasons this project matters so much to me.

We're producing _Star Spangled Adventures: The Movie_ --a new film created specifically for children to help them understand America's story through engaging, clear, and inspiring storytelling. It's designed to be something families can watch together and trust.

As our nation approaches its 250th anniversary this year, I believe we have a responsibility to be intentional about the stories we pass on. What the next generation believes about our country, and about themselves, will be shaped by what they're taught today.

I'd like to invite you to take a simple pledge to stand with us.

When you take the pledge, you'll receive **exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming,** along with updates as the project moves forward and opportunities to help bring stories like this to life.

The pledge says:_I believe it is crucial to support projects like this to help raise a generation of children who understand and value the truth about our country --so that truth is not lost to the next generation._If that reflects what you believe, I hope you'll take a moment to sign the pledge and enjoy these exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming.

With gratitude,

Dr. Ben Carson

name: JB Pritzker
subject: Being blunt about New Hampshire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260906_2.rteGVD&refcode=em20260906-2&t=1&akid=8739%2E582294%2E-Q0PbR)
Governor JB Pritzker here.
Let me be blunt: **_Everything we care about is on the line in 2026 — and New Hampshire could decide the outcome._**
We’ve already seen the damage Trump’s second term is inflicting on our country: His ICE agents are once again targeting families in broad daylight -- tearing apart communities, rounding up workers, and instilling fear across entire neighborhoods. He’s gutting environmental protections while utility rates spike, forcing working families to foot the bill so his billionaire donors can cash out.
He has no interest in bipartisanship, decency, or democracy. **And if Democrats don’t take back the Senate this November, there will be nothing stopping him.** That’s why we _must_ win in New Hampshire.
**[Chris Pappas is running in a tied race that could decide Senate control. Chip in $5 now to help him win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260906_2.XnJ6mi&refcode=em20260906-2&t=2&akid=8739%2E582294%2E-Q0PbR)**
Trump and his MAGA allies are laser-focused on New Hampshire. They’ve recruited a big-name candidate, they’re lining up GOP billionaire donors, and they know if they win here, they’ll shut the door on a Democratic Senate majority.
We can’t let that happen.
Chris Pappas is a fighter. He’s taken on Big Pharma, defended reproductive freedom, and delivered for working families in one of the toughest districts in the country.
I want him in the Senate. But we’re all going to have to come together to get him there. He’s running in a true battleground. His race is tied. And the GOP machine, desperate to keep Democrats locked out of power, is ready to bury him in dark money and attack ads.
**[That’s why I’m asking-- urgently -- for your help: Can you chip in $5 to help Chris Pappas win in New Hampshire and give us a fighting chance to stop Trump?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260906_2.XnJ6mi&refcode=em20260906-2&t=3&akid=8739%2E582294%2E-Q0PbR)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260906_2.XnJ6mi&amount=5&refcode=em20260906-2&t=22&akid=8739%2E582294%2E-Q0PbR)**
The damage is real. The stakes are massive. And the time to act is right now.
Thank you for standing with Chris and for standing up to the madness.
JB Pritzker
Governor of Illinois
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

subject: Get Ready for Tuesday!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Paige Beauchemin for Congress
body:
| |
---
Power, Prosperity, Peace
| Dear Supporters, We have a huge opportunity on Tuesday: to show the nation that everyday Americans are taking their power back. We can unseat an incumbent who has shown herself time and again to be out of touch with Granite Staters. Tuesday's primary is anticipated to have [strong but typical turnout](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=16035da4cce311bf9bb7438a52fbc41bd8e3f9db&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yahoo.com%2Fnews%2Fpolitics%2Farticles%2Fnh-expected-strong-turnout-tuesdays-224600503.html). Let's make it even stronger. Let's turn out in higher than expected numbers**and get Paige elected!** This is our shot!
* * *
**Keep telling people about Paige** Team Paige was at the NH 50501 people's primary rally yesterday. Multiple people approached us and told us that after seeing Thursday's debate, they will now be voting for Paige. Please forward this email to five people you know. Tell them to watch [the debate](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=eac543c7f5c09dd4c66cf52771285bd4ce9355b9&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3D7vfOqqBIp14%26t%3D919s). If they're short on time, encourage them to watch [this pivotal moment](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=a6a9d12b067be60b851004a39248c731c2c27ae2&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3Dp1FI6rNp1F8%26t%3D88s).
* * *
**Get Ready for Tuesday ☑️** If you live in New Hampshire and are not yet registered to vote, [here is what you need to know](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=e6069c0129569241ba03a1df6d41b98a702e7080&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FcQXVJrnwmAn6ryEQP9z9YUPU7cXYKFeP%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3Da632bd95ad98e5dc70a28d7cf00f4bb0a7bdccb4%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.sos.nh.gov%252Felections%252Fregister-vote). New Hampshire offers [election day registration](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=4a20939535003d6174f30a9304dfccf797b19f74&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sos.nh.gov%2Felections%2Fregister-vote%2Fpolls-election-day). If you're an independent (undeclared) voter, you can still vote for Paige on Tuesday! Here is [what you need to know](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=de766e25f571f427bd16e45bd7be833b09624564&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sos.nh.gov%2Felections%2Ffrequently-asked-questions%2Fvoting-party-primaries). Already registered? Confirm your voter registration. [Check Your Voter Registration](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=f889daafe815daf336a15c4ca005963b7a0fcd9d&url=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.sos.nh.gov%2Fvoterinformation%3Femci%3D03baeb99-62a1-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d%26emdi%3D86a72a34-67a1-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d%26ceid%3D611823) **Make your plan 📋** Do you have everything you need to vote? Review the [Election Day voting requirements](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=9d3eddef2af9344e23b52833a8a5294fd82b4bf8&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FcQXVJrnwmAn6ryEQP9z9YUPU7cXYKFeP%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3D05f1e02adefcd04b3569514f456d618e25a52c82%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.sos.nh.gov%252Felection-day-voting) to make sure you know what to bring. _Please note: Student IDs are no longer accepted as voter identification in New Hampshire._ Confirm [your polling station location and hours](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=58ccb05520c6c993dcfb168f9337f6de573b3ca1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FcQXVJrnwmAn6ryEQP9z9YUPU7cXYKFeP%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3D0e0a6a2154e5d357cf109fad48b1245ca9968cb4%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fapp.sos.nh.gov%252Fpollingplacesampleballot). Schedule your trip to the polls into your calendar. Give yourself the time you need. Consider anything you need like childcare - kids are always welcome at the polls but depending upon your family's needs you may want another trusted adult to watch them while you vote. If you need a ride to the polls, ask a trusted friend or family member. **Consider your friends, family and community 🏠** Do the people in your life have the information they need to vote? Share these resources with anyone who might need them. If someone you know needs a ride to the polls and you feel comfortable driving them, offer them a lift. **Most importantly** , [take care of yourself.](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/4up2ltvSLEeDgP4rdHq2bAswNVMChO75/click?signature=a64d0e0b4ad8b7e14c6e69397384ddf24d947fbf&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FcQXVJrnwmAn6ryEQP9z9YUPU7cXYKFeP%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3D394f0cb7d612eb1ccc3796b8fd6f1ab07b751456%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fmakinithappen.org%252Felection-day-self-care-tips-for-all-of-us%252F) Questions, concerns, or feedback? Reply to this email. Team Paige is here to help through Election Day. | | Peter,
There is an unholy alliance forming in America that should not be possible.
**On one side stand revolutionary socialists who believe there is no God at all** – and that America will not be free until every trace of its Judeo-Christian foundation is scrubbed out of our schools, our courts, and our public life.
**On the other stand political Islamists who believe their god must rule** every one of those things absolutely, and that no other faith has any rightful claim to exist beside it.
They disagree about the most fundamental question a human being can ask – _and yet they have found each other._
**Because they have found the same enemy.**
That enemy is not a political party. It is not a candidate. **It is the Christian faith** – the last thing standing between both of these movements and the world they intend to build.
---
[ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8a29371cabe84bad9c2de0e19afe4e26&_e=hmzYamlVs2rUMkl0sxkMsYSgHOFyqSklBCZphxyxCN1xPIr9b2mtMqwQ2nf1xS_OfJIUFbbksstEB4tJiMX7_RAh5h3t3uEdLeW_dJXQ7HRCR6jn4KbBbL4gFRV3DMXFEI01gpoQWOeO8Q0zcnnB_2viLD-3Hkio_4UKg5pAUyWszASDNRgvot6NyZPsijT4DAiWidjwZL2g9rjg2UeIkM5LfCAFtNO_ruP9Oiy10eUn899_NGJYy2YjutZCQdhpiljQT4YLK8ZzkmrscNn_qLVTloF2qSyQHC1Y1FSYOHUbDjJUcttCHYrDCz7rFOdwOC3mSio4P0rfyOGAxkpsNl6fJ1507yn659OCUH8MqwW02rJbLuOql-O__NmolUuLUtshu2xCBSQ_OaNOS3ojKBUtph5clLpcyjnOeAsuisIsLqOELICFyjotOLw-7rwi00bP3xQ1ZY4hoJbBpZ9q-BOuBb9WxRtZXxxL_FRo_Bff3LYQypu-i5auPAAO2y3Nae14wVosJOTGAIyBs2V8ZAwA61IBXqNmvKUtm7vNYgY03wqadwiqsKr7SJ59-xcxqi6LNEw4KvVKPOPOr5in-7ZL9GwI3-O05g1VWGzmk0AFxkHwcR4JPq6vV1YWgVfDNSACbsQhhhiukn15nfCi-SZBAWTd4tXrd5UCCDAs3MV1-hyuH-UNnJpFrveA2_Yy53ujGbzhYJVTXZz7zqeLl9rXMC8FQJl9XVFrWXuBgAPfQzkiDCkfdXYZSQmqqWw1D4RiTI41tJQl_g6qbvuKlyGsiGfMLEqwTSZHNMiou5Cxspq1QPkT1iEJKAo_6BsyWESfpEdDoSSzWlpTLLb_Lw%3D%3D)

President Trump named the first threat plainly:
"These ruthless communists will attack all religions, but in particular Christianity. They always do. They're after Christianity more than any other religion."
He is right, and history proves it. Every communist revolution of the last century began by locking the church doors. In China, _Pastor Ezra Jin spent 266 days in prison_ for leading one of the country's largest underground churches. Eight of his fellow pastors are still behind bars. In North Korea, _owning a Bible can cost you the rest of your life in a labor camp._
Secretary of State Marco Rubio named the second:
"Radical Islam isn't content with controlling a single region or establishing a small caliphate. Its ideology is revolutionary. It aims to grow, to dominate, and to exert control over more lands and more populations."
That is the whole project of political Islam: **placing religious power above every constitution, every court, and every conscience. **There is no room left in it for religious liberty. No room for a man to read the Gospel and decide for himself that it is true.
And if you want to know what that project does to a man who decides exactly that, consider Nissar Hussain.

---
Nissar left Islam and gave his life to Jesus Christ. For that, he spent seventeen years being hunted. Not in Tehran. Not in Nigeria. _In Bradford, England._
His kneecap was shattered in an attack outside his own home. His car was set on fire. His children were taunted in the street as "infidels." His family lived under police protection for nearly a decade.
_Not one bishop of the Church of England stood with him._
Nissar's "crime" carries a death sentence in eleven nations on this earth.
Now look at what happens where this ideology governs without restraint.
**In Nigeria, more than 100,000 Christians have been massacred since 2009. 19,000 churches burned or destroyed. Five million men, women, and children driven from their homes. **
This is not history. _It is now._
Just before midnight on July 26, militants entered the village of Naridon and went house to house, shooting. **Thirty Christians were killed. Eleven were children. The youngest was three years old.**
On August 1, thousands gathered for a single funeral Mass. _Twenty-seven caskets._
That is not a distant tragedy. That is the destination.
**And that ideology now has political sponsorship inside the United States – with a partner supplying it lawyers, funding, and votes.**
**Start in Dearborn, Michigan.**
Pastor Lorenzo Sewell prayed at President Trump's inauguration. Today he says Christians there come to him quietly, from every corner of the city, with the same message: "I'm with you, but I'm afraid to say it."
**Afraid to say they follow Christ.** _**In America.** _
Sewell describes a city where the call to prayer is broadcast over loudspeakers, where the public schools certify that every ounce of meat served to children is prepared according to Islamic ritual law, and where his own wife's life was threatened – the man's name and address handed to police – and nothing happened.
"Think about being in a Christian nation," he said, "being afraid to talk about Christ."
**Then look at our schools.**
At two of the top public high schools in Virginia, students filmed promotional videos for their Muslim student clubs showing classmates hooded, dragged away, and thrown into car trunks – weeks after the anniversary of the October 7th massacre. The district disciplined them. Congress opened an investigation. And then a national Islamic advocacy group hauled the school system into federal court, _arguing that punishing the students was itself discrimination._
The provocation comes from one side. The lawyers come from the other.
**Then look at New York City.**
_The largest city in America is now run by a self-described Democratic Socialist who took his oath of office on the Quran_ – elected with six figures of help from a network of Islamist organizations, including one whose leaders have been tied to terror-financing investigations. It's why he can visit a mosque in the morning and march in an LGBTQ parade that afternoon.
The socialists supply the political machine and the moral cover. The Islamists supply the ideology and the money. Neither could do this alone. _Together, they are formidable. _
**"If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first."** – John 15:18
Jesus told us this would come. He did not tell us to be silent about it.
**This is precisely why Save the Persecuted Christians exists. We guide a coalition of over 200 organizations fighting this battle on both fronts at once – because they are the same battle.**
✅ We brought Nissar Hussain to America and put him before members of Congress.
✅ We helped drive the campaign to redesignate Nigeria a "Country of Particular Concern," laying the groundwork for real sanctions and accountability.
✅ Our educational efforts helped fuel the 95% vote by Texas Republicans to prohibit Sharia law – and the launch of the Sharia-Free America Caucus, now 60 members strong across 25 states.
**388 million Christians** – _**one in every seven believers on earth** _ – **live under threat right now for the same faith you are free to practice openly this morning.**
That freedom is not a possession. _**It is a responsibility.** _

At two of the top public high schools in Virginia, students filmed promotional videos for their Muslim student clubs showing classmates hooded, dragged away, and thrown into car trunks – weeks after the anniversary of the October 7th massacre. The district disciplined them. Congress opened an investigation. And then a national Islamic advocacy group hauled the school system into federal court, arguing that punishing the students was itself discrimination. The provocation comes from one side. The lawyers come from the other. Then look at New York City. The largest city in America is now run by a self-described Democratic Socialist who took his oath of office on the Quran – elected with six figures of help from a network of Islamist organizations, including one whose leaders have been tied to terror-financing investigations. It's why he can visit a mosque in the morning and march in an LGBTQ parade that afternoon. The socialists supply the political machine and the moral cover. The Islamists supply the ideology and the money. Neither could do this alone. Together, they are formidable. "If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first." – John 15:18 Jesus told us this would come. He did not tell us to be silent about it. This is precisely why Save the Persecuted Christians exists. We guide a coalition of over 200 organizations fighting this battle on both fronts at once – because they are the same battle. ✅ We brought Nissar Hussain to America and put him before members of Congress. ✅ We helped drive the campaign to redesignate Nigeria a "Country of Particular Concern," laying the groundwork for real sanctions and accountability. ✅ Our educational efforts helped fuel the 95% vote by Texas Republicans to prohibit Sharia law – and the launch of the Sharia-Free America Caucus, now 60 members strong across 25 states. 388 million Christians – one in every seven believers on earth – live under threat right now for the same faith you are free to practice openly this morning. That freedom is not a possession. It is a responsibility. | "DEFEND THE FAITH" Thank you for standing with those in need. name: Public Land Warriors
subject: The uranium rush just hit Bears Ears
body:
Jumped the gun on their own backroom deal

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/5DsdWrzB3EJMeh2DxI_Fgw~~/AAUS1hA~/8V05PMmk5wWg6XoWCLLtufKPpmcpsF3feQ3Au64mMyrLqZHf5hruj5i11K_EyKgKEeNuxb403Ds2WN-XMZHnVuvMngM9HkiuwUCenLW2vEmVyO3B0oLtdH0Q4zsCBTQI)
| | | | Peter, Just weeks ago, the Trump administration slashed Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante by over 90%. **Now, according to public records, at least nine mining claims have already been staked inside the former boundaries of Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante.** Corporate mining executives are literally racing to claim massive reserves of uranium and vanadium on land that, until July 13th, was protected wilderness. [**This is a five-alarm fire for our public lands. Will you chip in $10, $25, or $100 today to our rapid-response war chest to help us fight this massive corporate land grab?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/KnxD-L16jSO4BB0KhDI6lQ~~/AAUS1hA~/9zKGUpg3V6DeJ96WeCCPANb7JycOGVFSQqyOFM8cCkuhx49kb6ZYBM3tgui7nlodwodZWHcCP1QZ_W5J-zHxlSW_-yBN_ejq9QnGdz9NWjXkHzxaVegIcGiT_frdd1hRoPkudKSx9b5gpVn5lf35op84Yc7hti53ZkX9ooswCw3ysydd0MtWRHOBKezAWumlo8pXBTCItjHxu3EtU_gAyejmJzFLTIfQgOjPHhss0l9Csry1T11qhk4dKIN7J3vy) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/KnxD-L16jSO4BB0KhDI6lQ~~/AAUS1hA~/9zKGUpg3V6DeJ96WeCCPANb7JycOGVFSQqyOFM8cCkuhx49kb6ZYBM3tgui7nlodwodZWHcCP1QZ_W5J-zHxlSW_-yBN_ejq9QnGdz9NWjXkHzxaVegIcGiT_frdd1hRoPkudKSx9b5gpVn5lf35op84Yc7hti53ZkX9ooswCw3ysydd0MtWRHOBKezAWumlo8pXBTCItjHxu3EtU_gAyejmJzFLTIfQgOjPHhss0l9Csry1T11qhk4dKIN7J3vy) ** The administration's own proclamation stated that new mining claims wouldn't even be legally allowed until September 11th. But executives like Kyle Kimmerle—who previously sued to shrink the monument because it "locked up" his minerals—filed seven claims the very next day. **They are so eager to bulldoze ancient cliff dwellings and pristine desert landscapes for a uranium mine that they are jumping the gun on their own backdoor deal.** They are testing the waters. They want to see how we’ll react. The mining executives are betting that the American public is too exhausted to fight back. When many of us were growing up, the stories we watched and read reinforced things like character, responsibility, and a basic understanding of where our country came from. Those stories weren't perfect--but they helped give us a sense of grounding.

Today, the media children are absorbing looks very different.

So much of what kids watch now either ignores America's history altogether or presents it in confusing and misleading ways. Children are forming their understanding of the world earlier than ever, and without a clear foundation, it's no wonder so many young adults today feel disconnected, uncertain, and adrift.

That's one of the reasons this project matters so much to me.

We're producing _Star Spangled Adventures: The Movie_ --a new film created specifically for children to help them understand America's story through engaging, clear, and inspiring storytelling. It's designed to be something families can watch together and trust.

As our nation approaches its 250th anniversary this year, I believe we have a responsibility to be intentional about the stories we pass on. What the next generation believes about our country, and about themselves, will be shaped by what they're taught today.

I'd like to invite you to take a simple pledge to stand with us.

When you take the pledge, you'll receive **exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming,** along with updates as the project moves forward and opportunities to help bring stories like this to life.

The pledge says:_I believe it is crucial to support projects like this to help raise a generation of children who understand and value the truth about our country --so that truth is not lost to the next generation._If that reflects what you believe, I hope you'll take a moment to sign the pledge and enjoy these exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming.

**Add your name to the pledge here:[**https://offers.americancornerstone.org/star-spangled-adventures-movie**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=3f822eb3f66e4d9f89145f145fb3080c&_e=2_1qYcIPoYAtaokO-kAQlbQcVeG1KlMBWeeKzOTg6YCU3nnY8h20QtdS90_WdFJKcakZJFZ--cJnKWAoC92DaCnebxlPtvy8CgEYORFZFpfnGJwMHQEcHt3zs4VHNie2AShydG-CetUZeTyE3p-bAV6T3htNnPmpYb4CKq0uZqTfiC2GsxOPgugp_kZB8rJsQO0suxhSJisT6vXPDHKao0vRxrMUdWCLXtmJnqYWxzY1goE7UgSg1U_npIE2kn-CbmBjvmc4gUFeghWjBMztyBfe8Z5IumPDsYmkj6ULyjurvqVLzP5fq9a7ywx4I9IeUtkx_TlZ2ADVLyDaEb5Jge_JtU-fgTFnLS3mx_AXt6Gt4J3DRO95jLFAuU9uKoUtkz9UNBQ2_YJbsBOic3t8jVBTGd5rO52vHphrHDGDlsMwPCiPA4hyaHoHVnJ_ua87WZT00Q8Ttwb4HlP3DKoqNQ5aQspNce2ph6BJcgw0GHSj5V5dJTBbWz-C-mOtiqaVFNfxRmfV99IXqd5znqnfkKPWPTzP_Yyh4sDZCff2cT8mNdX2H_QoEQSfKoViPuC1AY5O8wysnVCOQNAIjeHeujWyeoqO20d2qmDv8HjsLs_Nu4ByzfnBp-lVhxeSieVW9lgXkHfLUynsxmTMoF0IY18ylN0wjcaFRCWoYgWW4R4%3D)**

Thank you for caring about the stories shaping our children--and the future they will inherit.

With gratitude,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

body:
This is one seat we can flip to take back the House majority.
#
Peter, this is a big development in our fight to take back the U.S. House:
Latino voters are turning against Republicans in Colorado’s 8th Congressional district, opening a clear path to victory for Democrat Manny Rutinel.
According to the new survey, _**61**_ % of Latino voters in CO-08 disapprove of Donald Trump — _a massive 13-point jump in disapproval since last year._
Rutinel’s opponent, incumbent Republican Rep. Gabe Evans, is feeling the fallout, sitting underwater with a 42% disapproval rating in **a district where Latinos make up nearly 40% of the population.**
[****](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260906-1.uoWFqy&amount=3&refcode=em20260906-558&t=1&akid=558%2E1366028%2EfiRjim)
Manny Rutinel has the momentum — but we know National Republicans are going to spend _millions of dollars_ to protect this seat in this final sprint toward November 3.
That’s why we need your help, Peter. Voto Latino is on the ground, registering Latino voters, informing them about what’s at stake this Election, and making sure they turn out for Manny on Election Day.
**[Will you chip in $3 right now to help turn out Latino voters, flip CO-08, and take back the House?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260906-1.uoWFqy&amount=3&refcode=em20260906-558&t=2&akid=558%2E1366028%2EfiRjim)**

Thank you,

Every single day, I go to work in Washington as a firewall for North Texas. I fight to protect tax relief for our families, to keep our borders secure, to defend our energy jobs, to stand with our troops and veterans, and to keep our elections honest. It is the fight of my life, and I am proud of it. But I cannot pretend it is a fair fight right now. The radical socialist left is organized, motivated, and flooding races across the country with money to take back the House. This is a movement that just made a socialist the mayor of New York City and is sending its own candidates to Congress, and they are not hiding their goal. They are already celebrating the idea of running Washington and shutting down the Trump agenda for good. If we get outworked and outraised, they win the majority, and everything we have built gets reversed. So I am asking you, directly and humbly, to have my back the way I have tried to have yours. body:
We expect this to be a very close race.
#
Hi there,
As part of our ongoing efforts to keep this community informed about what’s happening in each of our target races, today, we want to take a look at the Senate race in Georgia, where **Senator Jon Ossoff** is facing **Republican Representative Mike Collins** in the campaign to keep this seat blue.
As a reminder, Mike Collins was Donald Trump’s endorsed candidate in the primary. He campaigned as a MAGA Republican, and we have every reason to believe that he would be a rubber stamp for Trump’s policies in the Senate.
**Meanwhile, Ossoff is the only sitting Democratic senator running for reelection in a state that Donald Trump carried in 2024.**
That makes this one of the most high-stakes defensive races in the country, considering Democrats need to defend every Senate seat they currently hold and flip four others to win control of the chamber.
And while polls from this summer have shown Ossoff with a lead, we still expect this to be a very close race:
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=sl-senate-2026.Ns7Ngr&refcode=em20260906-2673&t=1&akid=2673%2E1562180%2EbxrIO-)
_Table Credit: New York Times_
The good news is that Ossoff is no stranger to winning close races, and the Swing Left community helped him win his first Senate race back in 2021. Together, we can absolutely do it again.
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=sl-senate-2026.Ns7Ngr&refcode=em20260906-2673&t=2&akid=2673%2E1562180%2EbxrIO-)
**If you’d like to help Democrats like Jon Ossoff win their Senate races this November, one of the best ways to do that right now is by[making a donation to Swing Left’s Win The Senate Fund.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=sl-senate-2026.Ns7Ngr&refcode=em20260906-2673&t=3&akid=2673%2E1562180%2EbxrIO-)**
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=sl-senate-2026.Ns7Ngr&refcode=em20260906-2673&t=4&akid=2673%2E1562180%2EbxrIO-)**
This fund supports the Democratic nominees in the Senate races that most need financial support. That includes our Must-Flip races in Alaska, Iowa, Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, and Texas, and our Must-Hold races in Georgia, Michigan, and New Hampshire.
A portion of your contribution will also support Swing Left as we work to scale up Ground Truth, our innovative, volunteer-led deep-canvassing program that’s working to rebuild trust in Democrats and turn out voters in critical swing races and states across the country.
With Election Day just over 8 weeks away, we have an important window to take action right now. So thank you, as always, for doing your part!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. subject: This should alarm every American
body:
| | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138689950/644870779/1090555623?refcode=260906_roundtable&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmMyZDljOC0wYmFhLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fr2C3Q2myozPde6bU2vwqngAiNq3I0toCfHEJ8Fzcls=)
---
| | | What's happening right now across this country should alarm every single one of us.

Antisemitic attacks are surging. Islamophobia is spreading unchecked. LGBTQ+ Americans are facing threats and violence simply for existing openly. And South Asian Americans are experiencing hate, harassment, and violence at a level that demands more than words.

No American should feel they don't belong in this country because of where they were born, how they worship, who they love, or what their name sounds like.

I've lived that truth my whole life. And this week, I decided to act on at least one piece of it.

I brought together every South Asian member of Congress, along with state and local elected officials from seven states and leading advocacy organizations, for a national roundtable in Washington focused on the surge in hate targeting our community:

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138689951/644870780/1090555623?refcode=260906_roundtable&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmMyZDljOC0wYmFhLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fr2C3Q2myozPde6bU2vwqngAiNq3I0toCfHEJ8Fzcls=)
---
We discussed what our communities are actually experiencing right now, what's driving this surge in hate, and — most importantly — what we can actually do to stop it.

Here's the truth: Hate crimes across many different communities are dramatically underreported, and the federal government doesn't have a clear picture of what's really going on or why.

That's exactly why I reintroduced the Hate Crimes Commission Act earlier this year. This legislation would create a bipartisan commission to investigate what's actually driving this rise in hate — including the role social media and technology play in spreading it — so we can build real strategies to stop it, for every community being targeted.

**I've faced this hatred personally. I've had a sitting elected official call for the mass deportation of Indians and label me a "foreign occupier." I've watched a demonstrator tear an Indian flag apart while a crowd chanted hate. I know exactly what this feels like, and I refuse to let any community face it alone.**

This is exactly why I founded Equal Opportunity Now — to support leaders who will stand up and fight for every community being told they don't belong, instead of staying silent while hate goes unanswered.

[**Will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us keep fighting for a country where no one has to hide who they are?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138689952/644870781/1090555623?refcode=260906_roundtable&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmMyZDljOC0wYmFhLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fr2C3Q2myozPde6bU2vwqngAiNq3I0toCfHEJ8Fzcls=)

name: David Hogg
subject: This is what’s possible when we back bold leaders
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We’ve had incredible momentum so far — but we need your support to keep this movement strong through the midterms.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260906-1&t=1&akid=3978%2E587540%2EumCkMM)
Peter,
Leaders We Deserve started with a simple idea: young people deserve leaders who will actually fight for them and give them hope for the future — not corporations or billionaires.
Since our organization’s start, we’ve been able to back incredible, bold progressive leaders who are dedicated to delivering real change for their communities.
Here are some of our elected candidates recent wins:
* **Rep. Akbar Ali,** Georgia’s youngest legislator, helped push through a 60-day suspension of the state gas tax while prices were skyrocketing. He helped deliver real relief to Georgians at the pump.
* **Mayor Zohran Mamdani** has secured a $1.2 billion deal to deliver universal childcare, and won over $34 million in settlements from predatory landlords to repair thousands of New York apartments.
* **Congressman Christian Menefee** has introduced legislation to prevent gun tragedies through safe firearm storage and fought back against Republican bills that would’ve cut food assistance for working families.
* **Rep. Nabeela Syed** has passed legislation to stop price gouging on generic drugs and expand access to lifesaving breast cancer screening.
* **Rep. Ruwa Romman** introduced the first statewide data center moratorium in history, and led the push to stop monopoly utility companies from shifting corporate expansion costs onto working families.

These are just a few of the meaningful wins our elected candidates have delivered — **and every one of them started with people like you deciding to back a daring young leader, instead of settling for the status quo.**
Now we’re heading into the final stretch of the biggest election cycle in our organization’s history. We’ve won 34 races so far, and endorsed more candidates than we ever have before.
But we still have critical, difficult fights ahead of us — seats we need to flip from red to blue to break the GOP’s grip on power in Congress and state legislatures in every corner of the country. And we need supporters like you with us in this fight to help us do this work.
**[This is your moment to become part of what we’re building. Every win we secure — you’ll have a piece of it, too. Will you make your first $5 contribution, or whatever you can today, to fuel our work and power our endorsed candidates through November?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260906_1_supporters.Xzw2FI&refcode=em20260906-3978&amount=5&t=2&akid=3978%2E587540%2EumCkMM)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260906_1_supporters.Xzw2FI&amount=5&refcode=em20260906-3978&t=21&akid=3978%2E587540%2EumCkMM)**
Thank you for your support.
— David Hogg

**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20260906-1&t=22&refcode2=3978_587540_umCkMM&akid=3978%2E587540%2EumCkMM)**

subject: We’re worth more than our labor
body:
Our fight for liberation is deeply interconnected. | | | Hi Peter — Happy Labor Day weekend from all of us at United We Dream! Labor Day exists because working people like us organized for it. The weekend, paid time off, and workplace protections we rely on were won by people who refused to accept that their lives belonged to someone else. ✊🏽 At United We Dream, we know our fight for liberation is deeply interconnected. Immigrant or not, if you're a working person in this country, our lives are being treated as disposable by those in the highest seats of power. That's the whole strategy — keep us divided and exhausted so we can't see that millions of us are facing the exact same thing. **As we collectively face a moment meant to divide us, we have to have each other’s backs.** **[United We Dream develops organizers in communities across the country to support the working-class solidarity we need to build a better country for all. Every June,
the Supreme Court hands down its biggest decisions — then goes dark for
three months while the country deals with the fallout.

Here's what they left behind this year.

#1: Stripping legal protections from over a million immigrants.

Last term, the Court let Trump strip legal protections from more than a
million immigrants who'd been living and working here legally. One
decision, no hearing, uprooting over a million lives.

#2: Gutting the Voting Rights Act.

In Louisiana v. Callais, the Court gutted the Voting Rights Act and
cleared the way for states to racially gerrymander their maps. The rule
now is simple: you can dilute the power of voters of color, as long as you
don't say out loud that that's what you're doing.

#3: Corporations win. They always win.

Give this Court a choice between checking Trump's power and expanding it,
and they expand it. Give it a choice between protecting people and
protecting corporate power, and corporate power wins. That's the pattern.

The Supreme Court’s conservative majority is a rubber stamp for whoever
holds the most power in the room — and right now, that's Trump and the
billionaires and corporations bankrolling him.

This has to change.

Demand Justice is leading the fight for real Court reform: an expanded
bench, an enforceable ethics code, and structural changes that end
unaccountability. But taking on the highest court in the land takes
immense resources, which is why we’re coming to you.

Peter, 22 state attorneys general are suing to block the merger of Paramount and Warner Brothers―two historic entertainment conglomerates that, if successfully merged, would put **CBS News, CNN, TikTok, and HBO all under the same corporate umbrella.** Our nation’s founders put freedom of speech, freedom of the press, and freedom of assembly as the First Amendment because that right undergirds all of our other rights. George Washington, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, and their ilk were concerned that another king would spring up in America, and they wanted to ensure that could never happen. These freedoms give us the power to stand up to a totalitarian government without fear of reprisal―and these are exactly the freedoms that the Supreme Court has been stripping from us as they allow Donald Trump to assume monarchal authority. **This merger would put a Trump ally in charge of the news.** When coupled with Trump’s FCC chairman’s threats to pull broadcast licenses from networks who air critical coverage of the president, it would represent a dangerous loss of our freedoms. That’s _why_ we have an FTC. That’s _why_ we have anti-trust laws―to prevent any one entity from growing so powerful. These laws haven’t been enforced as consistently as they should, but now is the time to use them. [**Send a message to Congress: Protect the first amendment! Investigate and stop Paramount’s pro-Trump takeover of Warner Brothers!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxKT4Onj3G7OlyRicdbWy_b2tbUgHORkawxMU060QImaI_8ZgMmXmrmA4_tOB2svGOD5hv5JUUAKDWYE7aQlgfl8nGdJB5JQLoQKOUC54US91B3RDlA3yb7NRTVnVe6gGtwfTtc5_QtU3Z1eLDW3mVRayXfO8HIVK7YlbsvvGWjQD7UqF3sagv_h30bexJz-bg2VLkUcNuuNd-wbReLhpE9Se8U1o4pV3A9ILYZYyU2ERFxXsZRV16jtTNN4m2-_PbLjiJo5JnbJLqIJjipfpXfhwSRowfHo10f2iDgxiHPjAA3N7aljMKqbjKoh7eBWoRp-_aCkdtS3Pc-i9aaShEEQSutLFB0GIWRbi4vudNFeTwkm1zrfsHr4IHvkv3-b8-xjtCOafAicy6WXhIuTKEoAsDOlVylflp8iQxAPrgMbzY5Y2CdFP9uLXC-8U8XgWIewWRx5Yg1GKBfZT6oyDHXw/4tt/ztI4_bJmR2qZnheWpWNyrA/h0/h001.yMdcKJ5RTE0Clb_UY5UTRFoa2BB6n0WpiZ01FBST07o) Thank you, Ken’Travius Coleman

When coupled with Trump’s FCC chairman’s threats to pull broadcast licenses from networks who air critical coverage of the president, it would represent a dangerous loss of our freedoms. That’s why we have an FTC. That’s why we have anti-trust laws―to prevent any one entity from growing so powerful. These laws haven’t been enforced as consistently as they should, but now is the time to use them. Thank you, Ken’Travius Coleman United for Democracy Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . After 30 years in Washington, she’s become a corporate puppet who does the bidding of her billionaire donors and Donald Trump – she’s voted with him 96% of the time.

subject: Quick update on my race before Wednesday's vote!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of AnderBois
body:
| |
---
Hi friend, In the final days before the election, I've been out in the field talking to hundreds of voters. I've shared my positive, forward-thinking vision for the Lieutenant Governor's office. And I've watched voters go from believing the office is a $1M waste to understanding its true potential, if we elect the right kind of leader to the office. Meanwhile, my opponents have started taking swipes at one another over the corporate money flowing in. In a close and crowded race, candidates will often try to get the media's attention by going on the attack. But this isn't my way of doing things. Throughout this campaign, I have shared that I have never really seen myself as a "politician." I don't see politics as a game to be won or lost. I see it as the way public servants earn the trust and respect of those they aim to serve. So in a world that is negative enough already, I remain undeniably positive and hopeful that our government can really work for us. That we can elect leaders who won't be bought by corporate interests, lobbyists, developers, or whoever will fork over the most cash. I am beyond proud of the grassroots support we have built in the past few months. Getting our message out throughout the state -- on TV, digital, over text, and more -- is no small feat. And it's all thanks to people like you who know that Rhode Islanders deserve more.
---

| | Dear Friend,

Here's a story I'll never forget, once I learned the truth behind it.

In 1917, a small group of revolutionaries led by Vladimir Lenin seized power in Russia. They promised a better, fairer world...sound familiar?

But soon after taking control, they began rounding up and executing anyone who stood in their way. Lenin even ordered his followers to hang landowners and seize their crops--so that for miles around, "people see, and tremble..."

Marxism began with promises of a perfect world--and ended in fear, famine, and death.

You may be familiar with that dark history, but too many Americans aren't. How do I know?

Because a century later, these dangerous ideas have been repackaged and rebranded. They're taught in schools and promoted by celebrity politicians using words such as "equity," "diversity," and "social justice."

The words sound harmless, but the ideas behind them are the same. Will they end up with the same terrifying results?

That's why Hillsdale College has created the National Quiz on Marxism, Socialism, and Communism, and I'd love for you to take it.

This short quiz will test your knowledge of the history and real-world consequences of dangerous ideologies like Marxism and socialism.

And when you finish, we'll email you the answers, and you can watch our free online documentary-style course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism," which tells the whole story--from Lenin's Red Terror to today's Cultural Marxism.

Most young Americans have never learned this history. I know I didn't in high school. But you can help change that with your financial support today.

[After you take your quiz, please also consider giving a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or even $100 to help us share this free course with millions of Americans](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/4KV8HhIQwZMsAbCpH8o5l65SfkQx536roPQsufbtgAwaDpwOaJsipzYRtOusJwW5C3UD_8ojRCydxs6XXuLb_JCECmuh2Nzs5zEmp68_ckUFxb2vxyAkFCr8881jZ69srOXHCTtpB3k64bk1zR8KOvsLyht6Djbu9KjVr1zj8ktS0IZHCa2mflnt2rM6aJPI0TglPJr4c_P8bhhaK_CkjGSeZZG6HRNPHgbvqqf2rRFD-15vcerX1-TYIi_2Ug9u17wXF63qGSnOI4rUYH5TgGMEVDrrxnet0ngo7uKK4xuDFxpBwpyXtr0yGyF9b2hLNgnJ2nXfcW6E6JyHCHlTRt-cXCUmJAcU0u_k_m_6GELNvswLeJwa-oiJs2IhDNYmlJ7gx4M7dEG3w-15N6m07BQ6c_HivZTnDfWrEkVmPj1_eTI5DZHqPQYM-FLXaet0zfhY1gVS1HnYujqNjvCE9F2ibb3NSxPUCMagUH-9ZwvsfQUzN7Vozoss83GmbOU2WTDxI9_Lzzu5VGNzze237S-nWB3FoEb4GTHU2HkTsZCEqyvBP5NwtmlvY8yrb7PNIuwJu9IMJJQpQcgQGd3Rzdqy4jDE-nWgq8oi_0Hd7odefjZ6KxU52_mV3ovrqLICcTLiT0jGHGzDfe48j80ac0uUzme7nX-vme9qzHH623hdJ_PtRTGzCwMepbRXb_JDQhxE/Y8a2i5hYPV0nrDRgE_-0kTrITNLUYZ6z/24)--especially young people who are misled by the same false ideas that once brought such misery to Russia and the world.

At the end of this month, our campaign will file our last end-of-quarter fundraising report.
This report will show how much money we've raised and will be available to everyone: journalists, supporters and opponents. It's one of the **biggest** indicators of where a race stands and a strong end-of-quarter showing carries significant weight. So on September 30th, as we close the books on our last end-of-quarter this election, we'll have the chance to show my opponent and Republicans just how strong our movement really is.
[Donate now](https://substack.com/redirect/b152a314-28ad-48f0-aba7-cc617d6c6b92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Last quarter, 95% of our donations were $100 or less, and nearly one-third of them were from first-time individual donors. That's the reason we've been able to keep this movement funded, support our ground game, put more ads on the air and keep reaching voters all across North Carolina.
But the other side isn't slowing down. Republicans and GOP super PACs have already committed nearly $100 MILLION so far to spreading lies and trying to buy this seat. In fact, they are running crime ads against me now that are just false. But your grassroots donations are helping to fund our ad we just put on air that sets the record straight.
And after a recent Supreme Court ruling lifted all restrictions on how much money political parties can spend in coordination with campaigns, the GOP has more opportunity than ever to keep flooding this race with money.
Right now, supporters like you are the most important thing standing in their way.
[Donate now](https://substack.com/redirect/b152a314-28ad-48f0-aba7-cc617d6c6b92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Whether you've knocked doors, chipped in when you could or just stayed up to date on this campaign: **Thank you.** None of this happens without you.
But this fight is far from over and we'll need all the help we can get to make this our strongest end-of-quarter yet. This is our chance to prove that North Carolina doesn't want a Big Oil and utility company lobbyist as your next Senator.
I've spent my career fighting for working families and focusing on what matters to people across our state. I'm ready to keep doing that in the U.S. Senate. But I need your help to get there.
We need to raise $5 million by the end-of-quarter to fund this campaign through Election Day. Any amount you are able to give will help us continue to knock doors, reach voters and keep our ads on the air. We are in the most critical part of this election, and I need your help to make sure we can finish strong.
**[WIll you chip in $5, or whatever you can spare, to help carry us through the finish line, flip North Carolina blue and show my opponent how strong we are?](https://substack.com/redirect/b152a314-28ad-48f0-aba7-cc617d6c6b92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
[Donate now](https://substack.com/redirect/b152a314-28ad-48f0-aba7-cc617d6c6b92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
P.S. If you want to learn more about what FEC deadlines are and why they matter so much to campaigns, you can read our explainer [here](https://substack.com/redirect/b00e1e03-e94c-4dee-a594-d0248ea0c120?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
